messages:
dana: Heads-up: customer Orion flagged a May invoice with both a full reserved-commit and a transfer-prorate for the same seats. Looks like double billing during a seat reallocation.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-412 generated for account orion-llc. Total $9,740. PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-412 (auto-note)
chet: Can you paste the three lines?
dana: snippet:
```
LineItem: RESERVED_COMMIT   Period: 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31  Amount: $6,000  CommitID: rwd-commit-213
LineItem: TRANSFER_PRORATE   Period: 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-12  Amount: $1,840  From: acct-main To: acct-sub
LineItem: OVERAGE_BURST  Period: 2026-05-13 to 2026-05-31  Amount: $1,900
```
chet: Looks like we billed both sides of the transfer. Short fix: create credit memo for $1,840 and update PDF. Need finance approval > $1k.
revenue-ops: Approve up to $5k. Also open BLG-3578 to track root cause: transfer should be atomic.
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-0248 for $1,840 created (pending-post). Ticket BLG-3578 referenced.
chet: After CM posts, update invoice to INV-2026-412-v2 and notify account rep. Also queue a dev task to add a transfer-lock to prevent duplicate commits.
dana: Thanks  closing loop once CM posts and dev ticket assigned.
